messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
shin waini jamaa miye laifin mahmud duk fa wanda yasamu dama irinta mahmud wallahi i have confidence sai ya dama for that i think mahmud is right

output.original_text: shin waini jamaa miye laifin mahmud duk fa wanda yasamu dama irinta mahmud wallahi i have confidence sai ya dama for that i think mahmud is right
output.joy: Shin, waini jamaa, me ya sa ba zamu yi murna da dama irinta Mahmud ba? Wallahi, ina da babban kwarin gwiwa cewa ya dace, saboda wannan, ina tunanin Mahmud yana da gaskiya!
output.sadness: Shin waini jamaa, me laifin Mahmud? Duk fa wanda ya samu dama irinta Mahmud, wallahi, ina da kwarin gwiwa, amma ina jin ba daidai yake ba, don haka ina ganin Mahmud yana da hakkin sa na karshe.
output.fear: Shin waini jamaa, me laifin Mahmud? Duk fa wanda ya samu dama irinta Mahmud, wallahi, ina da kwarin gwiwa, amma akwai wani abu mai ban tsoro da ya jawo hankalina a kan Mahmud. Daga cikin tunani, ina jin kamar ba na da tabbas.
output.anger: Shin waini jamaa, me laifin Mahmud? Duk fa wanda ya samu dama irinta Mahmud, wallahi, ina da kwarin gwiwa, amma abin takaici ne in ga yadda ake zargin Mahmud. Ina ganin Mahmud yana da gaskiya!
output.surprise: Shin waini jamaa, me laifin Mahmud? Duk fa wanda ya samu dama irinta Mahmud, wallahi, ban yi tsammanin hakan ba! Ina da kwarin gwiwa, saboda haka ina ganin Mahmud yana da gaskiya!
output.disgust: Shin waini jamaa, me laifin Mahmud? Duk fa wanda ya samu dama irinta Mahmud, wallahi, ina da kwarin gwiwa, amma na ji zafin zuciya kan wannan batu. Duk da haka, ina ganin Mahmud yana da gaskiya.
